notes: United Spay Alliance's Feline Fix by Five programme, for getting kittens spayed or neutered by five months, before they can have litters of their own. Listed by the Mayor's Alliance among the spay/neuter finders. A reviewer confirmed this on the organization's own site on 2026-11-03. The site shows automated checks a bot test, so the weekly check cannot read it and a person re-confirms it instead.
